intervals.estimators, ablation, auroc_diff: mean over repeats and central 95% range of the per-repeat values (split variability)
intervals.brier_diff: 95% percentile bootstrap over questions of per-question differences in mean test Brier loss
intervals.brier_p: two-sided paired sign-flip permutation test over questions
intervals.reliability: test predictions pooled over all repeats
intervals.risk_coverage: per-repeat curves interpolated on a coverage grid, averaged
